_comment: Manually researched from official Government of Kerala sources, 2026-09-11. Coordinates from landrevenue.kerala.gov.in 'Locate Us' embedded Google Maps pins (official) unless noted otherwise (geocoded). Cross-check each against the correct local body polygon before trusting; a mismatch is flagged, not silently used.

village_offices.coordinate_caution: identical (to 3dp) to the Cheriyamundam VO pin below — likely a copy-paste error in the government CMS; verify against ward polygon before trusting, discard if it falls outside Ponmundam

notable_bridges.name: Thooval Theeram Floating Bridge (Ottumpuram Beach)
notable_bridges.description: A ~100 m pedestrian floating bridge into the sea at Ottumpuram / Thooval Theeram beach, Tanur — Kerala's first such structure. Inaugurated 23 April 2023 by Tourism Minister P.A. Mohammed Riyas.
notable_bridges.osm_reference_point: OSM node 4570963189 'Thooval Theeram Ottumpuram Beach. Tanur' — 11°01'14"N 75°51'23"E (approx. 11.0206, 75.8564)

notable_bridges.name: Tanur–Theyyala Road Railway Over Bridge (ROB)
notable_bridges.description: Road-over-rail bridge on the Tanur–Theyyala road, Tanur town, carrying the road over the Shoranur–Mangaluru railway line. Declared 03/01/2020; construction documented as in progress in 2023 (Tanur Municipality Facebook, Oct 2023).

notable_bridges.name: Chamravattom Regulator-cum-Bridge
notable_bridges.description: 978 m regulator-cum-bridge across the Bharathapuzha (Nila) river near Chamravattom/Triprangode, connecting Tirur and Ponnani taluks. Inaugurated 17 May 2012. Location needs checking against the Tanur AC boundary — it sits on the Tirur/Ponnani taluk boundary, likely just outside or on the southern edge near Niramaruthoor/Thanaloor.
